All 8 backend + all 7 frontend smoke checks pass. NOTE: Report file is /app/test_reports/iteration_418.json — main agent requested 417 but that name was already occupied by the prior test cycle; I preserved history and used the next number 418.
action_items: OPTIONAL (P3): Remove dead code — /app/frontend/components/PhaseStep2TabbedView.tsx L297-395 defines ZygomaAdvancedClinicalSection component that is never instantiated in the JSX (grep confirms 0 usages). The advSection style at L587 is only consumed by this dead component and can be removed with it.

OPTIONAL (P3): The AdvancedClinicalCard's 'adv-send-approval' TouchableOpacity is only rendered when approvalStatus === 'draft' (L230). The spec allowed 're-sending' after edits — consider allowing re-send in 'approved' or 'pending' state if user needs to correct Day 30 later. Current behaviour is defensible (once sent, block is locked from re-send by the same user).

OPTIONAL (P3): Consider adding an in-app warning-confirmation dialog when 'Send for Approval' is tapped with Day 30 empty (spec mentioned 'in-app warning confirmation'). Current implementation goes straight to backend without a partial-submission warning Alert.
